# Vocabulary: opportunity_type

Kind of opportunity.

| id | label | definition |
|---|---|---|
| `new-mechanic` | New mechanic | A rule-system that did not exist in shipped games. |
| `mechanic-upgrade` | Mechanic upgrade | An existing mechanic made qualitatively deeper or broader. |
| `new-genre` | New genre | A recombination that could define a new design lineage. |
| `legibility-layer` | Legibility layer | Makes deep simulation understandable without simplifying it. |
| `authoring-tool` | Authoring tool | Developer- or modder-facing tool that changes what small teams can build. |
| `infrastructure` | Infrastructure | Runtime, engine, or platform component others build on. |
| `business-model` | Business model | New way of distributing, monetizing, or operating simulation games. |
| `non-game-transfer` | Non-game transfer | Simulation-game mechanics applied to research, policy, training, or agent evaluation. |
